ops.body:
Hold install for config (Recommended)
Question: Installing the new long-running plugin makes every live runner (80945/81016, durable-agents-rebuild) re-exec into it at the end of its pass with its current config, which has no orca.sprite, so every eligible unmarked launch would then refuse. Which adoption order do you want once the PR is merged and released?
Options: Hold install for config (Recommended) | You edit configs now | Install right after release
